articles.title: IBM Expands FedRAMP Portfolio with Authorization of 11 Software Solutions, Including watsonx
articles.mainIdea: IBM Expands FedRAMP Portfolio with Authorization of 11 Software Solutions, Including watsonx
articles.summary: PR Newswire: IBM Expands FedRAMP Portfolio with Authorization of 11 Software Solutions, Including watsonx. IBM (NYSE: IBM) today announced that 11 of its artificial intelligence (AI) and automation software solutions — including several products from the watsonx portfolio — have received Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP) authorization. These authorizations were made possible through IBM's strategic collaboration agreement (SCA) with Amazon Web Services (AWS), which includes investment to speed the delivery of AI and automation solutions for federal agencies. articles.title: IBM ETH Zurich Quantum Alliance And What It Could Mean For Investors

articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: IBM ETH Zurich Quantum Alliance And What It Could Mean For Investors. IBM (NYSE:IBM) and ETH Zurich have agreed a 10 year collaboration focused on next generation AI quantum algorithms. The partnership targets both scientific and enterprise use cases, including new professorships and dedicated research projects. The announcement underscores IBM's intention to shape future computing architectures and talent pipelines for AI and quantum.
